items.title: Show HN: Dropbox for AI Skill Files
items.summary: I built mdkit, a menu bar app for storing and sharing skill markdown files. Just drop your .md files into mdkit to store them in the cloud, then drag them out whenever you need them. Share files by email with viewer or editor permissions. Every save is versioned. Why I built it: I wanted a simple, AI-platform-independent way to share and manage AI skills across teams, with features like editing permissions and version history. mdkit is in beta and free to try on Windows and Mac. Genuinely just trying to find out if this is useful for anyone. Would love feedback!
